scope: 142 named targets and 75 provisional-designation entries from the discovery index checked against DAMIT, plus targeted mission/radar source checks. This is a dated archive survey, not proof that no other model exists or a claim to have qualified every non-asteroid entry.

physicalSizeContinuation.description: Same-body original DAMIT meshes scaled through the existing physical-units reader using separately published size measurements. Thermal effective diameter transfers remain approximate, with statistical and systematic limitations disclosed. The archive models themselves remain marked uncalibrated where appropriate; this is an application-level physical scale with provenance, not a DAMIT archive reclassification.

spacecraftApproximationContinuation.scope: Two previously deferred original-mesh candidates now have explicitly labelled published-dimension approximations. Their original global reconstructions remain unresolved. Historical archive observations above are retained.
